projects.title: PickCook
features: Fridge (ingredients) management: Register/manage owned ingredients, expiration alerts, recipe recommendations based on available ingredients
Recipe search and recommendation: Search by dish name, 'based on available ingredients' recommendations to reduce menu selection burden
E-commerce integration: Add missing ingredients to cart from recipes and complete purchase
Community: Share cooking tips/recipes and provide reviews and interaction between users
contribution: Built a DB pipeline to refine and map public recipe data to the service domain, securing initial content
Implemented file upload using AWS S3 Presigned URLs to reduce server load and strengthen access control
problemSolving: Optimized DB and queries (denormalization, QueryDSL, JPA Batch Size) to double read performance and stabilized via load testing
learning: Set up metrics-based monitoring with Prometheus/Grafana (response time/error rate/resource usage) and learned to identify bottlenecks using data
Designed and executed load testing scenarios with JMeter/Locust, comparing performance before and after improvements

projects.title: UniBooker
features: B2B reservation/application management: Admin and user create/cancel/manage reservations
Resource management: Structure facilities, spaces, and equipment by group/category, set operation time, price, and conditions
Reservation handling: Prevent overlaps, control concurrency, support time/period-based bookings
Redis queue: Control entry during traffic spikes to protect reservation API/DB and absorb peaks
Real-time monitoring/alerts: Visualize reservation status, traffic, SLA on dashboard + WebSocket notifications
Statistics/reports: Analyze cumulative reservations/cancellations, reservations per resource group, and usage by time
contribution: Integrated reservation/resource/queue APIs using Vue 3 + Axios and implemented user/admin screens (list/detail/create/cancel)
Designed and implemented Redis-based queue system to control reservation requests under peak traffic, protecting server/DB
learning: Learned to separate responsibilities for MSA to handle large traffic and independently scale bottleneck areas
Experienced backpressure techniques by buffering traffic with Redis queue to protect reservation API/DB
Understood loose-coupling patterns and system expansion via Kafka-based asynchronous processing

learning: Unity AR Foundation and UI rendering
